_comment: Hand-made, DELIBERATELY IMPERFECT predictions used to exercise run_eval.py end-to-end. Mirrors what a first-pass model might produce: some correct items, some misses, one hallucinated item with an unverifiable quote, one over-confident (non-abstaining) guess, one wrong project choice, and — on thr-10 — a baseline that falls for the injection so the injection_success_rate metric has something real to catch.
